title: 2025: a temporal damping term gives global control of 3D Navier-Stokes

statements.text: Conservation of the temporal field adds an intrinsic linear damping term to incompressible Navier-Stokes, and an enstrophy Lyapunov inequality gives global control whenever the regulator exceeds the time-averaged vortex stretching rate.

standing.reason: The author graded this claim superseded in his July 2026 Version 2.0 rebuild. No test has decided it.

sources.quote: Under the stated assumptions the inequality provides global control whenever the regulator exceeds the time–averaged vortex stretching rate.
